sloka: परिघाभिहतश्चापि वानरेन्द्रात्मजस्तदा।जानुभ्यां पतितो भूमौ पुनरेवोत्पपात ह ।। ६.७०.१८ ।।
transliteration: parighābhihataścāpi vānarendrātmajastadā।jānubhyāṁ patito bhūmau punarevotpapāta ha ।। 6.70.18 ।।

translations.english: Then, hurt by the club the son of Vanara king fell down on his knees once again and got up.
